posts.author: Radical Nox
posts.body:
Hi everyone! I just wanted to share few of my icons/tiles/edits I made for my project.
Terms of use are stated in spoilers.
Spoiler:
Icons
They are made by me. Some Berserk-themed gear, Evangelion Lance of Longinus and more.
-Don't re-post or claim as own - even edited.
-You can use them in non commercial projects, just let me know and credit me please.
-If you want to use them in commercial project, ask me first.
Spoiler:
Characters
Random sitting smoking npc, made with help of 'whtdragon' template.
-You don't have to credit me for it.
-Edit of MV's sprite, you will need a legal copy of RPG maker MV.
-Credit 'whtdragon'
Spoiler:
Tiles
This stained glass is made by me.
-Don't re-post or claim as own - even edited.
-You can use them in non commercial projects, just let me know and credit me please.
-If you want to use them in commercial project, ask me first.

posts.author: SmashArtist
posts.body: That stained glass design is beautiful! And I'm loving your icons as well, great work!

posts.body:

Again - I am glad you like it! - And I like you!
